states.name: Manchester
states.title: Exorcist Knight of the West
states.description:
At a young age, her talents were recognized by the Western Exorcist Church, and she became a knight devoted to hunting wraiths.
Despite her slender appearance, she possesses the strength to swing a massive blade with ease, and her reliable work has earned her the deep trust of the Church.

states.name: Manchester
states.title: Exorcist Knight of the West
states.description:
She was the eldest daughter of her family. With her parents gone, she had to care for her many younger brothers.
To make sure they could all eat their fill, she prioritized efficiency above all else in her work, heading directly home as soon as she completed an exorcism.
Because of this, more than a few people have assumed her to be an aloof and uncaring knight.

states.name: Manchester
states.title: Exorcist Knight of the West
states.description:
However, the most important battlefield for her is not the struggle against wraiths, but the bargain sale at the local grocery store.

"Sorry, those potatoes are mine!"

The sight of her snatching up her prey in the blink of an eye have left other customers struck with fear and awe, and the locals have nicknamed her the "Paladin of the Sale Rack."
